description: Phase 4 churn stream large tier (N=50): 50 clients form one group (same flow as the formation-burst large tier), converge, then a sequential join/leave churn stream runs 6 cycles (one fresh client joins and connects presence, one formed client disconnects presence) with settle delays longer than the coalesced recompute debounce so each membership change is a distinct topology input change. Admin group-formation and rtc-topology metrics are captured per server at T0 (pre-formation), T1 (formed, pre-churn), T2 (post-churn), and T3 (after a ~60s steady-state heartbeat window), so the churn window T2-T1 isolates per-change replan, publication, and egress quantities. Assertions are correctness/liveness only; churn quantities are recorded, never judged, so the recipe can baseline the pre-phase-4 tree and measure the phase-4 tree with the same instrument. Authored with the recipe fragments mechanism; this file is generated so the client flows stay mechanically identical to the burst tiers.
